question: What takes place when you click the Save button or press Ctrl + S in Microsoft Word?

options.text: The document is copied to the clipboard.
The document is saved in a disk file.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The document is saved in a disk file.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The document is saved in a disk file.** This action ensures that all the changes made to the document are stored on the disk.
 
• When you click the Save button or press Ctrl + S, **Microsoft Word writes the current state of the document to the storage medium**, preventing data loss.
